methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series C → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.7x) to $129M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Candela is a Series C transportation company that has raised €129M+ to date. The broader transportation tech sector includes eight private peers at various stages (notably Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Slate Auto, and ZeroAvia), with no direct public comparables available for triangulation.

The valuation analysis applies stage-progression methodology, which is suitable given the company's defined Series C checkpoint. Using total capital raised (€129M) as a baseline proxy and applying a typical 1.7x step-up multiplier associated with Series C to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of €219M. A peer-median approach was not applicable; while three same-sector peers exist in transportation, none satisfied minimum thresholds for same-stage or adjacent-stage matching with sufficient datapoint density (requiring ≥3 comparables), making sector-wide median estimation unreliable.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of €186M to €252M, centered on €219M. This reflects meaningful uncertainty bands around the point estimate, reflecting the methodological constraints inherent in valuing early-stage frontier-tech companies with limited public market anchors and a fragmented peer set. The primary vulnerabilities in this range are the absence of tight Stage C comparables in transportation and reliance on a single calibrated method. Key sensitivities include the reasonableness of the 1.7x step-up multiplier for this particular sector and capital-efficiency profile.
